lastCompletedStory.title: Signal MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT promotion from decideNextAction at the cap boundary

nextStoryContext: US-001 added promoteVerdictTo?: 'MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT' to the complete and await-operator variants of SupervisorAction. The next story (US-002) should wire this signal in loop.ts: when decideNextAction returns a terminal action with promoteVerdictTo set, loop.ts must persist MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT as prd.review.lastVerdict before exiting. The pure-function contract in decide.ts was preserved (no I/O). All existing loop.ts call sites still typecheck because promoteVerdictTo is an optional field.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure TypeScript logic change to decide.ts and its tests; no external libraries involved.
